name: Singpass

scam_info.sample: Singpass will never send you links or QR codes via SMS or WhatsApp.
scam_info.notes: Official anti-phishing guidance: check for singpass.gov.sg plus the lock icon; passkeys only work on official Singpass logins. Offers account suspension and unauthorised-access reporting. The sitemap has only 5 URLs (/, /download, /help, /passkeys, /security; no lastmod). No scam alert list or feed. Singpass phishing advisories are published by SPF (e.g. 20220318, 20221002, 20220728 joint with IRAS).

notes: Heavily impersonated (SPF brand tag "Singpass", 2 advisories; fake login pages on workers.dev). Hosts seen in page links: portal.singpass.gov.sg, developer.singpass.gov.sg. sms.gov.sg lists Singpass as sending from gov.sg; older SPF advisories (2022) mention "Singpass"/"SingPass" sender IDs from before the 1 Jul 2024 consolidation. go.gov.sg/even-safer-singpass is an official short link. The helpdesk number 6335 3533 and "The official website for Singpass is singpass.gov.sg" are from SPF advisory 20220318 (fetched 2026-11-26 HTTP 200).
